name: Set DNS Provider
description: Switches your network adapter to a specific DNS provider like Cloudflare or Google for faster lookups, but does not increase raw internet speed.

description_i18n.en: Switches your network adapter to a specific DNS provider like Cloudflare or Google for faster lookups, but does not increase raw internet speed.
description_i18n.de: Wechselt den Netzwerkadapter auf einen bestimmten DNS-Anbieter wie Cloudflare oder Google für schnellere Suchanfragen, erhöht aber nicht die Roh-Internetgeschwindigkeit.
description_i18n.fr: Basculer l'adaptateur réseau vers un fournisseur DNS spécifique comme Cloudflare ou Google pour des recherches plus rapides, mais cela n'accélère pas la vitesse brute de connexion.

warnings.title: required
warnings.message: This tweak requires an elevated administrator session to modify network settings

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies IPv4 server addresses in the registry under HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces and uses Set-DnsClientServerAddress to apply changes
